tagline.en: Cleveland to Columbia, through the middle of the Appalachians
tagline.zh: 从克利夫兰到哥伦比亚，纵穿阿巴拉契亚腹地

mileageSource: FHWA Route Log and Finder List, Table 1, January 2026

start.zh: 南卡罗来纳州凯西，与 I-26 相接

end.zh: 俄亥俄州克利夫兰，与 I-90 相接

en: I-77 runs from Cleveland to Columbia and takes the hard way south, straight through the middle Appalachians rather than around them. It largely replaced US 21 and remains the most direct route between the eastern Great Lakes and the Carolinas, which makes it a heavily used seasonal corridor as well as a freight route.

The scenery is earned. Between Charleston, West Virginia, and Wytheville, Virginia, the road climbs and descends almost continuously, passing through two long mountain tunnels. South of them it drops off the Blue Ridge escarpment at Fancy Gap on a long sustained grade with runaway truck ramps on the downhill side and a climbing lane for northbound traffic.

The West Virginia section is different again in kind, not just in terrain: eighty-eight miles of it are a toll road that was built before the Interstate system and rebuilt inside it, and drivers still pay to use it.
zh: I-77 自克利夫兰通往哥伦比亚，南下时走的是难走的那条路——径直穿过阿巴拉契亚中段，而不是绕开它。它基本取代了 US 21，至今仍是五大湖东部与南北卡罗来纳之间最直接的通道，因而既是季节性客流走廊，也是货运通道。
沿途风景是挣来的。在西弗吉尼亚州查尔斯顿与弗吉尼亚州威斯维尔之间，道路几乎不停地爬升与下降，并穿过两条长山岭隧道。再往南，它在范西山口跌下蓝岭陡崖，那是一段漫长的连续坡道，下坡一侧设有卡车避险车道，北行方向另设爬坡车道。
西弗吉尼亚段的不同不只在地形，更在性质：其中八十八英里是一条收费公路，建成于州际公路系统之前，又在系统之内被重建，司机至今仍要付费通行。

en: Two tunnels carry I-77 through the ridges on the Virginia–West Virginia line. The Big Walker Mountain Tunnel near Wytheville took five years to build and opened in 1972; at the time it was the most expensive single project ever undertaken on Virginia's Interstate system. The East River Mountain Tunnel at Bluefield was broken ground in 1969 and finished in 1974, and it carried the biggest price tag of any West Virginia Department of Highways project to that date.

East River Mountain is unusual in that the state line runs through it, so Virginia and West Virginia split the cost. Both tunnels are twin-lane bores with lane changing permitted, replacing crossings that used to go over mountains above three thousand feet on roads that closed in fog and snow.

The West Virginia Turnpike further north was an engineering compromise of a different kind. Built in the early 1950s on a revenue-bond budget that would not stretch to four lanes, it opened mostly as a two-lane road with occasional passing lanes, and had to be widened and largely reconstructed two decades later to carry Interstate traffic.
zh: 两条隧道把 I-77 送过弗吉尼亚与西弗吉尼亚州界上的山脊。威斯维尔附近的大沃克山隧道建了五年，1972 年通车；它在当时是弗吉尼亚州际公路系统上造价最高的单项工程。布卢菲尔德的东河山隧道 1969 年破土、1974 年建成，是西弗吉尼亚公路局当时造价最高的项目。
东河山隧道的特别之处在于州界从隧道中穿过，因此弗吉尼亚与西弗吉尼亚分摊了费用。两条隧道都是双车道洞，允许变道，取代了此前翻越海拔三千英尺以上山口、遇雾遇雪就要封闭的旧路。
更北面的西弗吉尼亚收费公路则是另一种工程上的妥协。它建于 1950 年代初，收益债券的预算撑不起四车道，通车时大部分只有两车道，间或设置超车道，二十年后不得不拓宽并大规模重建，才能承担州际公路的交通。

en: The West Virginia Turnpike is the one part of I-77 whose finances were laid bare at the time, because bondholders in dozens of states had money at stake and the arrangements ended up in court. The commission issued revenue bonds in 1952 against an estimated project cost, then had to come back for a second issue in 1954 when landslides forced expensive corrections.

The final bill worked out at a figure per mile that was almost unheard of for the period, and the road was still only two lanes for most of its length. It was brought into the Interstate System in 1958; the 1968 Federal Highway Act allowed Interstate money to be used for its reconstruction after a consultant concluded that rebuilding would be cheaper than building a new road alongside, and the 1970 act allowed the tolls to stay.
For the rest of the route there is no comparable accounting. The Ohio, North Carolina and South Carolina sections were built with ordinary federal aid recorded by state and year.
zh: 西弗吉尼亚收费公路是 I-77 上唯一一段当年财务被彻底摊开的部分，因为分布在数十个州的债券持有人有钱押在上面，相关安排最终还打到了法院。管理委员会 1952 年按估算造价发行收益债券，1954 年又因塌方迫使代价高昂的整改而不得不追加第二期。
最终账单摊到每英里上，在那个年代几乎闻所未闻，而这条路的大部分路段仍然只有两车道。它 1958 年被纳入州际公路系统；在顾问得出「改建比在旁边另建新路更省钱」的结论后，1968 年《联邦公路法》允许动用州际公路资金对其重建，1970 年的法案又允许继续收费。
路线的其余部分没有可与之相比的账目。俄亥俄、北卡罗来纳和南卡罗来纳段都是用按州、按年度记录的普通联邦补助资金建成的。

why.en: No public figure exists. Five states built the route between the early 1950s and the mid-1990s, one long section began as a bond-financed state toll road that predates the Interstate programme, and federal cost records were kept by state and fiscal year rather than by route.
why.zh: 无公开数据。五个州自 1950 年代初至 1990 年代中期建成本路线，其中很长一段最初是以债券融资的州属收费公路，早于州际公路计划；联邦造价记录按州和财政年度而非按路线统计。

value.en: 606.78 miles across 5 states; longest in West Virginia at 189.33 miles, shortest in Virginia at 60.04
value.zh: 606.78 英里，横跨 5 个州；西弗吉尼亚州最长，189.33 英里；弗吉尼亚州最短，60.04 英里

figures.source: FHWA Route Log and Finder List, Table 1, January 2026

value.en: $96 million of revenue bonds at 3.75 per cent in 1952 and $37 million more at 4.125 per cent in 1954, against an estimate of $78 million; the finished 88-mile road cost $133 million, close to $1.5 million a mile
value.zh: 1952 年按 3.75% 利率发行收益债券 9,600 万美元，1954 年又按 4.125% 追加 3,700 万美元，而最初估算为 7,800 万美元；这条 88 英里的道路最终耗资 1.33 亿美元，接近每英里 150 万美元

figures.source: e-WV: The West Virginia Encyclopedia, West Virginia Turnpike; Guaranty Trust Co. of New York v. West Virginia Turnpike Commission, 1959; The New York Times, 3 September 1954

value.en: $50 million, five years' construction, opened 1972; more than 4,200 feet of twin-lane bore
value.zh: 5,000 万美元，施工五年，1972 年通车；双车道洞长度逾 4,200 英尺

figures.source: FHWA, The Big Walker and East River Mountain Tunnels

value.en: $40 million, broken ground 1969 and completed 1974; 5,400 feet long, with the Virginia–West Virginia line running through it and the cost shared between the states
value.zh: 4,000 万美元，1969 年破土，1974 年建成；全长 5,400 英尺，弗吉尼亚与西弗吉尼亚州界从中穿过，造价由两州分摊

figures.source: FHWA, The Big Walker and East River Mountain Tunnels

why.en: No agency publishes a route-wide figure. Counts are collected per segment by five state transportation departments, and the West Virginia section is additionally measured in toll transactions by the West Virginia Parkways Authority.
why.zh: 没有机构发布全线数字。交通量由五个州的交通部门按路段采集；西弗吉尼亚路段还另由西弗吉尼亚公路管理局按通行费交易笔数统计。

timeline.en: The West Virginia Turnpike opens — the first 36 miles on 2 September and the rest that November — as a mostly two-lane toll road costing $133 million.
timeline.zh: 西弗吉尼亚收费公路通车——首段 36 英里于 9 月 2 日开放，其余在当年 11 月——这是一条大体只有两车道、耗资 1.33 亿美元的收费公路。

timeline.en: The turnpike is brought into the two-year-old Interstate System.
timeline.zh: 这条收费公路被纳入成立两年的州际公路系统。

timeline.en: AASHO approves extending I-77 south from Charlotte to Columbia on 23 June.
timeline.zh: 6 月 23 日，美国州公路官员协会批准将 I-77 自夏洛特南延至哥伦比亚。

timeline.en: The Big Walker Mountain Tunnel opens near Wytheville, Virginia, along with the first stretch of I-77 between Wytheville and Bland.
timeline.zh: 大沃克山隧道在弗吉尼亚州威斯维尔附近通车，威斯维尔至布兰德之间的首段 I-77 同时开放。

timeline.en: The East River Mountain Tunnel is completed on the Virginia–West Virginia line.
timeline.zh: 东河山隧道在弗吉尼亚与西弗吉尼亚州界处建成。

timeline.en: The I-81 overlap between Wytheville and Fort Chiswell is built, joining what had been two separate I-77 segments in Virginia.
timeline.zh: 威斯维尔至福特奇斯韦尔之间与 I-81 的共线段建成，把弗吉尼亚境内原本分离的两段 I-77 连成一体。

timeline.en: AASHTO formally recognises the completion of I-77 south to I-26 on 22 April.
timeline.zh: 4 月 22 日，美国州公路及运输官员协会正式确认 I-77 南延至 I-26 完工。

timeline.en: The interchange with the Ohio Turnpike between Akron and Cleveland is completed in December.
timeline.zh: 12 月，阿克伦与克利夫兰之间与俄亥俄收费公路的立交建成。
